mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT semester_label FROM guestbook_notes WHERE state = 'normal' ORDER BY semester_label DESC
mapper.sql: n.note_id AS noteId, n.semester_label AS semesterLabel, n.display_name AS displayName, n.user_id AS userId, n.content, n.font, n.ink, n.paper, n.align, n.marks_seed AS marksSeed, n.tape, n.tilt, n.state, n.created_at AS createdAt, n.updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT d.drawing_id AS drawingId, d.note_id AS noteId, CONCAT('/api/guestbook/drawings/', d.drawing_id, '/image') AS imageUrl, d.pos_x AS posX, d.pos_y AS posY, d.width_pct AS widthPct, d.rotation, d.opacity, d.sort_order AS sortOrder FROM guestbook_drawings d WHERE d.state = 'normal' AND d.note_id IN #{id} ORDER BY d.note_id, d.sort_order, d.drawing_id

SELECT drawing_id AS drawingId, note_id AS noteId, file_url AS fileUrl, file_type AS fileType, pos_x AS posX, pos_y AS posY, width_pct AS widthPct, rotation, opacity, sort_order AS sortOrder, state FROM guestbook_drawings WHERE drawing_id = #{drawingId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO guestbook_notes (semester_label, display_name, user_id, content, font, ink, paper, align, marks_seed, tape, tilt, ip_hash) VALUES (#{n.semesterLabel}, #{n.displayName}, #{n.userId}, #{n.content}, #{n.font}, #{n.ink}, #{n.paper}, #{n.align}, #{n.marksSeed}, #{n.tape}, #{n.tilt}, #{ipHash})
mapper.update: UPDATE guestbook_notes SET display_name = #{n.displayName}, content = #{n.content}, font = #{n.font}, ink = #{n.ink}, paper = #{n.paper}, align = #{n.align}, marks_seed = #{n.marksSeed}, tape = #{n.tape} WHERE note_id = #{noteId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND state = 'normal'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO guestbook_drawings (note_id, file_url, file_type, pos_x, pos_y, width_pct, rotation, opacity, sort_order) VALUES (#{d.noteId}, #{d.fileUrl}, #{d.fileType}, #{d.posX}, #{d.posY}, #{d.widthPct}, #{d.rotation}, #{d.opacity}, #{d.sortOrder})
